description: Seguimos la luz de los que guiaron nuestro camino al éxito para alcanzar nuestros sueños y dejar una huella en el futuro.
summary:
An animated story starring Cass, a young girl who embarks on a journey through time alongside an ancient robot to complete a mission on Mars that her late grandfather left unfinished. During her adventure, she encounters various space instruments that have been left behind on the Red Planet. Through their stories, these instruments explain their history, why they were sent to Mars, and the roles they played in different missions. This allows Cass to discover their findings and understand the importance of their contributions to the exploration of the planet.
The story is accompanied by a video game that recreates the adventure through engaging challenges.
details:
To address this challenge, a science communication experience was designed that combines narrative and animation, with the purpose of recovering the history of different instruments that have taken part in the exploration of Mars. The proposal is based on a science fiction story with elements of adventure and time travel in order to present scientific information in language that is understandable for a young audience. In this context, the instruments become characters who narrate their own experiences, presenting their functions and the discoveries they made possible.


Innovative Aspects

  • Creativity: Personification of the instruments by giving them human characteristics.
  • Entertaining Storyline: Appeals to family bonds and adventure while leaving the reader with an optimistic message.
  • Female Empowerment: Features a female protagonist with adventurous qualities and a strong personality.
  • Simple Language: Simplifies NASA data to make it accessible and easy to understand for all audiences.
  • Scientific Outreach: The story serves as a first step in introducing new generations to space science.
  • Data Reliability: Information comes directly from NASA.
  • Eye-Catching Aesthetics: Uses a futuristic style with bright colors and a vibrant atmosphere.

Additional Features

  • Video Game: A game based on Cass's story.
  • Colombian Sign Language (LSC) Vocabulary: Key terms related to the project translated into Colombian Sign Language.
  • Braille Summary: A summary of the story available in Braille.
  • Character Descriptions: Information about the main characters and their roles in the story.
  • Team Introduction: A presentation of the members behind the project.
